question: Which of the following is the excretory organ of cockroaches and other insects?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malpighian tubules**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **excretory organ of cockroaches and other insects is the Malpighian tubule**
 
• **Malpighian tubules are unbranched tubules that float freely i**n the haemocoel and open into the alimentary canal.
 
• Malpighian tubules** absorb nitrogenous waste products **from the haemolymph and convert them into uric acid.
 
• They **also function as osmoregulatory organs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Excretion

 
 
• It is the** process of removal of nitrogenous waste**s from the body of an organism.
 
• Excretion is performed by a specialized group of cells or organs called excretory organs.
 
• **Different organisms have different types of excretory organs**
 
• **Eg**. Flatworms – Protonephridia & flame cells, Earthworms – Nephridia, Insects – Malpighian tubules, Crustaceans – green glands, All chordates - Kidneys
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Different organisms use different types of organs to remove excreta
